# noqeri/router 0.5.0

Allocation-free named-segment captures with bounded caller-provided offset arrays.

The older 0.1.1 exports are retained. This release is experimental and **not verified on native Noqeri platforms**. Capture output is a byte span and does not perform percent decoding or route authorization.

See `src/router.noqeri`, `tests/regression.noqeri`, and `tests/depth_regression.noqeri`.
